tex_content.label: thm:compactness-based-ricci-flows
tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Compactness theorem for based Ricci flows (Hamilton)] Let $(M_n,g_n(t),(x_n,0))$, $t\in (-T,0]$, be complete based Ricci flows. Suppose:

  1. there are $r,\kappa >0$ such that $B_{g_n(0)}(x_n,r)$ is $\kappa $-non-collapsed for every $n$;

  2. for every $A<\infty $ there is $C(A)<\infty $ such that $|\Rm |\leq C(A)$ on $B_{g_n(0)}(x_n,A)\times (-T,0]$ for every $n$.

Then a subsequence converges geometrically to a based Ricci flow $(M_\infty ,g_\infty (t),(x_\infty ,0))$ on $(-T,0]$.
